hero.description: Sttok is billed per company per year. Groups of more than 5 companies have a standard price per company. Companies with more than 50 shareholders have special rates. Some clients manage thousands of shareholders and business groups of hundreds of companies with Sttok.

plans.perYear: per company, per year (taxes not included)
plans.extras: Features with extra cost: shares or incentives marketplace.

items.a: Sttok is billed per company per year. The Basic plan costs €450 (up to 10 shareholders or beneficiaries), Advanced €650 (up to 20) and Pro €850 (up to 50). Groups of more than 5 companies have a standard price per company, and companies with more than 50 shareholders have special rates. Prices exclude taxes.
Communications, setup and support in Spanish and English. No hidden implementation fees. Integrated electronic signature is included in the Advanced and Pro plans.

items.q: Which features have an extra cost?
items.a: The shares marketplace (secondary market) and the incentives marketplace, from which liquidity windows are opened, are available as additional modules.

A few hours per company, including data migration from Excel or other tools. For groups with many companies, it depends on the number of companies. If the register is years out of date, Sttok rebuilds the history from the deeds in a few minutes.
Book a 30-minute demo with a corporate expert at calendly.com/sttok/30min. You will see the platform applied to your case before deciding.

items.q: Can I use Sttok outside Spain?
items.a: Yes. Sttok is used in Spain, Portugal, Andorra and Latin America. We invoice in euros or US dollars, with payment by card or international bank transfer. Support is in Spanish and English and data is hosted in the European Union. The shareholder register supports the share numbering and company types of each country.
